criteria.detail: All 34 acceptance criteria (AC-001..AC-034) are exercised by the feature suite and pass 34/34. No criterion is withdrawn.

33 of 35 tasks are completed in tasks.json and tasks.md. T7.3 (manual responsive/keyboard/French pass) and T7.4 (HTTPS/HSTS and PWA deployment prerequisites) remain unchecked with stated deferral reasons requiring a human or a running deployment.
traceability.json has 45 rows, all status complete, zero gaps. Every AC carries at least one TEST-### id (TEST-054..TEST-087).
Coverage = (34 tested ACs / 34 in-scope ACs) x 100 = 100%. Zero withdrawn criteria.
.sdrive/reports/tests/test-report-event-platform-expansion-v1-2026-11-15.md exists and is newer than both spec.md (2026-11-11) and plan.md (2026-11-11).
test-evidence.json records exitCode 0, summary.failed 0, summary.total 34, and commit 90f79f4 === HEAD.

Diff 47794a6...HEAD is 92 files, +15718/-560 across 14 commits, all attributable to this feature's plan; branch is based on the recorded base and no other feature's commits are present. FAIL because criterion 7 also requires a clean working tree and the full suite to be unaffected: the branch introduces 31 failures in six other approved suites.

No .only, xit, xdescribe, or unjustified skip in any of the 13 feature test files. All 34 AC IDs appear in test names (68 AC references). Red/green is not required: .sdrive/config.json declares no governance.requireRedGreen.

npm run lint passes (0 errors, 20 warnings; CON-204 satisfied) but npx tsc --noEmit exits 1 with 8 TS2741 errors in test/event-discovery-and-registration/event-detail.test.tsx, caused by this branch changing EventPageProps to require params: Promise<{slug: string}>.

No hardcoded secrets in the diff, no .env* file tracked, no secret-pattern hit. npm audit --omit=dev reports 0 critical, 0 high, 0 moderate, 0 low. All REQUIRED CON-51x controls are wired: CON-511/512 secure wrappers and requireAdmin, CON-514 rate limiter on wallet/door/events/registrations, CON-515 validators, CON-517 JSON-LD escapes <,>,&,U+2028,U+2029, CON-519 env-only secrets.
Feature suite is green (34/34), but the repository suite is red: 226 passed, 31 failed, 257 total across 11 files, none of them owned by this feature.
README.md updated (+18 lines) and documents PWA, wallet, and deployment prerequisites. CHANGELOG.md exists but was not updated for these user-facing changes.

NFR-007 (metadata p95 1.5s/3s), NFR-008 (2s live count, 150ms offline ack, 5s sync batch), and NFR-009 (WCAG 2.1 AA) declare measurable targets, but no performance or accessibility report exists for this feature under .sdrive/reports/. Cannot be recorded as verified.

Constitution contains no explicit Definition of Done checklist section; the DoD is evaluated as the union of CON-2xx/3xx/5xx/7xx rules. CON-204 and CON-207 hold; CON-703 fails on the typecheck half. CON-705 satisfied: the params Promise signature matches node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/page.md for Next 16.4.3.
sdrive verify event-platform-expansion --json returns warn with matched 90, missing 0, renamed 0, extra 85, withdrawn 0. No missing mapping.
CI not verified. The repository has no .github/workflows directory and gh run list --branch feature/event-platform-expansion returns no runs.

Reviewer kenule500 versus feature assignee (unset in workflow-state.json). No conflict to escalate.

findings.issue: This branch introduces 31 failing tests across 11 files in six other approved feature suites. Root causes are all in this branch's diff: (a) 18 tests in 7 files fail with 'useI18n must be used inside a LocaleProvider' because montage /my-events/[eventId] and other pages now call useI18n without a test render wrapper; (b) 8 tests in event-detail.test.tsx fail because EventPageProps now requires params; (c) 2 tests in check-in.test.ts assert the old combined 'Invalid or cancelled QR code' message that this branch split into 'Invalid QR code' and 'This registration was cancelled'; (d) 1 test in platform.test.ts expects the old getPublicStatus shape without defaultLocale.

npx tsc --noEmit exits 1 with 8 TS2741 errors. EventPageProps gained a required params: Promise<{slug: string}> to meet Next 16 conventions, but the existing test file still renders the page with no props.

NFR-007, NFR-008, and NFR-009 declare measurable performance and accessibility targets, but no performance or accessibility report exists for this feature. Accessibility is covered only by unit-level assertions, not a WCAG 2.1 AA audit.
T7.3 and T7.4 remain unchecked. T7.3 needs a human visual and keyboard pass at 360/768/1280 in English and French; T7.4 needs a running production host to confirm HTTPS/HSTS.
CHANGELOG.md was not updated despite user-facing additions (sponsors, custom registration questions, offline door mode, Google Wallet, currency and locale switching).

No deterministic secret scanner is installed (gitleaks and trufflehog both absent), so the secret scan was manual: diff regex sweep plus a tracked-file check. Install a scanner to make CON-519 evidence reproducible.
CI not verified: no workflow directory and no runs for the branch.

baseline.detail: Clerk JWT validated by Convex; no new unauthenticated mutating path.
No new raw query/mutation exports; secureQuery/secureMutation/requireAdmin used in events, platform, audit, exports, registrations, door.
Helmet is Express-specific; this project has no Express server.
Shared rate limiter wired in wallet.ts, door.ts, events.ts, registrations.ts as NFR-005 requires.
New fields declared with convex/values validators in convex/validators.ts and schema.ts.
Convex queries are typed and parameterized; no query strings assembled.
dangerouslySetInnerHTML introduced only in event-json-ld.tsx after escaping <,>,&,U+2028,U+2029; sponsor URLs restricted to HTTP(S).
State-changing calls are Convex mutations authenticated by a Clerk token, not cookie-driven form posts.
Wallet signing material read only from server env (GOOGLE_WALLET_*); no .env* tracked or committed.
